title: About
seoDescription: Operators, not advisors — the group structure, the story, and where we are.

Our Paraguayan operating companies raise the cattle, hold the ranch and herd operations, and contract with investors directly.","buttons":[]},{"type":"text","heading":"Our story","body":"Orbolo started with a simple question: how do you connect real, working ranches in Paraguay with the people who want to own a part of that supply chain, honestly and at conventional prices?

We built the loop — investors fund a herd, our ranches raise it, our trading desk sells the beef — so every part of the group has a reason to make the others work.

Today that means one farm we operate ourselves, a growing network of partner ranches, and a trading desk that gives every herd a buyer before it is bought."},{"type":"text","heading":"Group structure","body":"Orbolo facilitates, markets, and communicates for the group, and trades beef through its own trading desk. Orbolo does not collect investments or hold investor capital.

Our Paraguayan operating companies implement the cattle raising, hold the ranch and herd operations, and are the contracting parties for herd ownership.
